query:
UPDATE auctions
                SET
                    winning_bid = $1,
                    winning_user_id = $2,
                    winning_guest_id = $3
                WHERE auction_id = $4
                    AND (
                        winning_bid IS NULL
                        OR winning_bid < $1
                    )
                    AND (
                        winning_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM $2
                        OR winning_guest_id IS DISTINCT FROM $3
                    )
